svg.title: Architecture of financial report verification
svg.desc: An agent always interprets reports and supporting documents using OCR, layout and native evidence. Validation can request bounded reinspection. Deterministic code checks eligibility and completeness, calculates results, and preserves evidence. A local Docker application calls a configurable hosted model API and stores versioned runs in a persistent volume.
svg.text: Architecture as built: agent-led extraction, source evidence, deterministic reconciliation
Both the report and primary documents use the agent
Rich results in chat + evidence viewer
Native cells/tables and text for XLSX/DOCX
Extract facts, categories and service periods
Attach evidence IDs to each claim
Tools: page, crop, re-OCR, native cells
Apply contract, period and duplicate policies
Check coverage, units, signs and rounding
Matching sums do not prove completeness
Saved rich chat result + linked source evidence
Follow-up questions about the saved result
Every stage saves versioned artifacts. A replaced or added document starts a new full run; earlier runs stay readable.
Local first. One application container; the hosted model API is the only external dependency at run time.
API keys remain in the backend
OpenAI-compatible model API; OCR runs locally
Originals, pages, evidence, facts and results
Input hashes + app/tool/skill versions + model/settings in the run; model calls traced in /data.
Saved facts reproduce the calculation; fresh model responses can vary.
